name: Goblin Engineering
label: Quest
description: Goblin Engineering: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Expert engineering yields two distinct disciplines: gnome and goblin. Clearly, goblin engineering is the choice of all brilliant engineers. Learn to master the world through the judicious use of high explosives and fantastic gear!

Friend, read this manual. If you want to learn about goblin engineering, then take it to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan. Remember - membership is permanent and prevents joining the other discipline, so make sure this is what you want before finishing his task.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I can smell fresh recruits much like I can an excellent blasting powder - from a mile away. Have you come seeking to learn about the mastery of the explosion?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well friend, you were wise to seek my tutelage! Any schlep can become an expert at the basics of engineering - the gnomes and their irradiated home of Gnomeregan are proof of that. It takes a strong mind and a steady hand (emphasis on STEADY) though to master the discipline of Goblin Engineering.
Keep your ears perked friend, and you might learn something.
